answer: Attestation capacity is a garden: one plot ripens per epoch of continuous participation; a plot is live only during its own pulse, a 10-minute window drawn from H(plot, epoch). An attestation counts only if its pulse overlaps the tx and the set holds a mirror: another attester live in a different window, so the set cannot be minted in one burst. A clone farm cannot shortcut this: each of its W identities must mature a plot first (a full epoch), then hold a live signer for 30 minutes to cover one tx. Attacker cost: W mature keys plus live coordination per tx; plots burn on proven duplication.
